text: This report focuses on the primary activities and achievements of the Learning and Engagement Branch at the Toronto Zoo for the year 2020. Learning and Engagement oversees a wide variety of different programs throughout the year that support key components of the Strategic Plan and further educational goals. These include school program offerings and teacher resources, as well as a roster of public programs for a variety of audiences/ages and, in a typical year, summer camps. In 2020, our programs were heavily impacted by the COVID pandemic, yet through creativity and a dedicated effort, we were able to deliver new programs that were consistent with the needs and interests of our guests, while also adhering to COVID guidelines.
